example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ব্যবস্থাটা তো গোবরগঙ্গা, কোনো লাভ নেই।
তার কথা শুনে মনে হলো গোবরগঙ্গা ছড়ানো হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This arrangement is just a heap of cow dung, no benefit at all.
Hearing his words felt like cow dung was being spread around.
note: Refers to the common rural practice of piling cow dung, symbolizing worthlessness or mess in Bengali folk expressions.
